faq_add.q: How many CTEVT institutes are there in Nepal and who runs them?
faq_add.a: The official CTEVT mapping portal lists 669 institutes with an approved quota for 2083/84: 302 private institutes, 252 TECS technical school annexes inside community secondary schools, 65 constituent institutes run by CTEVT and 50 partnership institutes. By province: Bagmati 145, Madhesh 125, Lumbini 122, Koshi 92, Gandaki 65, Karnali 62 and Sudurpashchim 58. Kathmandu has the most (57), then Rupandehi (29), Dhanusha (28), Kailali and Dang (26 each). Pick your district on the course page to see the ones near you.

faq_add.q: Which CTEVT diploma has the most seats and which fills up fastest?
faq_add.a: By approved quota for 2083/84 the biggest are Diploma in Civil Engineering (7,720 seats in 161 institutes, plus 240 in the hydropower stream), General Medicine (5,982 in 149), Pharmacy (4,760 in 119), Medical Laboratory Technology (3,810 in 127) and Plant Science agriculture (3,520 in 88). The health tracks are almost full on the portal (General Medicine 5,917 enrolled of 5,982, Pharmacy 4,729 of 4,760, Nursing 2,558 of 2,560), while engineering and surveying fill slowly (Civil 1,559 enrolled of 7,960, Geomatics 207 of 1,776, Computer Engineering 561 of 2,296). That is a snapshot in November 2026 and enrolment is still being recorded.

faq_add.q: What is the difference between private, partnership, constituent and TECS institutes under CTEVT?
faq_add.a: The portal groups institutes in four types. Constituent institutes are run by CTEVT itself, such as Balaju School of Engineering and Technology or the Jiri Technical School, and the free scholarship seats for the poor and remote students are placed there. Private institutes are affiliated colleges and institutes that charge their own fees. Partnership institutes are run with another body under a CTEVT partnership (for example Madan Bhandari Memorial Academy Nepal, Tansen School of Health Science and Panchkoshi Polytechnic Institute). TECS is the CTEVT programme that runs technical courses inside general secondary schools: 252 of them hold a 2083/84 quota, with 217 diploma and 148 pre-diploma course entries between them. Ask which type you are applying to and who sets the fee.

faq_add.q: How do I check that a CTEVT institute is really approved for my course?
faq_add.a: Open mapping.ctevt.org.np, choose the year 2083, the level and the programme and then your province and district. The portal shows each institute with its approved quota and how many students are enrolled. An institute that is not listed for a programme has no approved quota for it this year, whatever its brochure says. Ask the institute for the CTEVT affiliation letter and the full fee schedule before you pay, and remember that CTEVT places its special scholarship seats at named institutes, so check the notice for your course.
